process_observations.observation: All three declared checkers exited 0 on the first pass with no repair pass, and their stdout matched the strings the planner recorded from its fixture run word for word ('No issues found.', 'No findings.', 'No issues found across 0 object file(s) and 2 field file(s).').

The two cited skills whose checkers the plan did not declare as step tests (record-types-and-page-layouts, sales-process-mapping) were run anyway per AGENT.md Step 8 and also exited 0; the record-type checker reported '2 record type(s), 0 layout(s); 0 finding(s)', which is the expected half-view at step scope because M1-S02 owns the layouts.

The step note pre-resolved the one trap that would otherwise have shipped a failing deploy - Q5's sign-off says 'Commit' while the metadata token is 'Forecast' - and the step's stage_values input already carried the token, so the answer and the artefact never had to be reconciled at build time.

The step declares a Percent field with an explicit precision and scale but does not cite admin/custom-field-creation, the only skill in the library whose element table carries <type>Percent</type>, <precision> and <scale>; the four cited object/picklist skills document neither element.

Assumption A24 is carried at risk high and is genuinely unresolvable inside a design-only build: the OpportunityStage file on disk is a fragment of eight values, and deploying it without the org's retrieved active values would deactivate the SMB team's stages - the single way this milestone could break the process requirement item 6 says it must leave alone.

Assumption A4 relies on OpportunitySettings.enableOpportunityFieldHistoryTracking defaulting to true while no step in the build ships an OpportunitySettings file, so nothing in this build verifies the assumption before stage history starts accruing - and history cannot be backfilled.

Two contracts disagree about where this run's report pair belongs: AGENT.md's Persistence sub-section names docs/reports/metadata-builder/<run_id>.{md,json} in addition to the build-scoped pair, while this invocation was scoped to write only inside the build directory; only the build-scoped pair was written, and the docs/reports copy was deliberately not.

A5 reads 'no other field needs a per-record-type picklistValues block beyond Approval_Status__c, which is identical on both', which can be parsed either as requiring a block for Approval_Status__c or as stating none is needed; it was resolved as 'none needed' because a brand-new record type receives all current master values by default (picklist-and-value-sets gotchas Gotcha 5) and both record types are new.
M1-S01 is built; the three declared checker tests plus the always-on xml and manifest checks and the two manual ticks are the tester's to run, not this agent's.

decision_record.question: opportunity-management: 'Which forecast bucket does each stage belong in, and who signed off on that mapping?'
decision_record.answer: Qualify/Discover Pipeline, Propose BestCase, Negotiate Forecast, Renewal Review Pipeline, Renewal Proposed Forecast, Closed Won Closed, Closed Lost Omitted. Signed off by the VP Sales Ops (Q5). The UI word 'Commit' in Q5's answer is written as the metadata token 'Forecast' per assumption A2.
decision_record.source: step inputs (stage_values) - the planner's explicit binding, which already carried the tokens

decision_record.question: opportunity-management: 'Which stages does each motion actually use, and which motion is the default?'
decision_record.answer: Enterprise: Qualify, Discover, Propose, Negotiate, Closed Won, Closed Lost (default Qualify). Renewal: Renewal Review, Renewal Proposed, Closed Won, Closed Lost (default Renewal Review). Two processes, two record types, per decision D2.
decision_record.source: step inputs (business_processes) + requirement.md item 1 + decision D2

decision_record.question: picklist-and-value-sets: 'Is the org's existing set going to be retrieved before I edit it?'
decision_record.answer: No - a design-only build cannot retrieve. The shipped file is an eight-value fragment and deploy-order.md section 0 makes the retrieve-and-merge the first, blocking instruction. Decision D1; assumption A24 at risk high.

decision_record.question: picklist-and-value-sets: 'Is this a standard picklist, and if so which StandardValueSet name?'
decision_record.answer: Yes - Opportunity.StageName is the StandardValueSet named OpportunityStage, which takes no wildcard, so the package.xml member is named explicitly.

decision_record.question: picklist-and-value-sets: 'Does anything depend on the value set staying open?'
decision_record.answer: Approval_Status__c ships <restricted>true</restricted> exactly as the step input declares it ('restricted Picklist: Pending, Approved, Rejected'). No data load or integration writes it - the approval process does (Q22).

decision_record.question: Which value is the default on the OpportunityStage file, and which on each process?
decision_record.answer: None of the eight stages carries <default>true</default>; all are explicitly false. The org's existing default must survive the section-0 merge untouched, because moving the org-wide default stage would disturb the SMB record type that requirement.md item 6 says must not break. The per-motion default lives on the business process instead (Qualify, Renewal Review).
decision_record.source: requirement.md item 6 + cited skill (picklist metadata-examples section 1: exactly one default true per file; opportunity-management metadata-examples section 2: BusinessProcess values carry their own default)

decision_record.question: record-types-and-page-layouts: 'Is this object Lead, Opportunity, Solution, or Case?'
decision_record.answer: Opportunity - so <businessProcess> is required on both record types, and carries the BARE process name inside the object definition while package.xml members are object-qualified.
decision_record.source: cited skill (record-types gotchas #6; opportunity-management metadata-examples section 2, api_meta.txt:42993-43008)

decision_record.question: record-types-and-page-layouts: 'Which picklist values differ between these processes, field by field?'
decision_record.answer: DEFAULT APPLIED - Q40 is open; the step's defaults_applied maps it to assumption A5: StageName is the only picklist that differs, and it is governed by the business process rather than by a picklistValues block. No picklistValues block is written for Approval_Status__c either, because a brand-new record type receives all current master values by default.
decision_record.source: documented default - assumption A5 standing in for open clarification Q40, plus admin/picklist-and-value-sets references/gotchas.md Gotcha 5

decision_record.question: record-types-and-page-layouts: 'Do records already exist on the record type we are changing or retiring?'
decision_record.answer: About 140 open Enterprise deals sit on the generic record type; Q8 makes the reassignment a one-time post-go-live runbook step, not a data-migration build, with no field mapping change. Recorded in deploy-order.md section 3 with the at-risk query to run first.

decision_record.question: record-types-and-page-layouts: 'Which reports, list views and Flow entry criteria filter on this record type today?'
decision_record.answer: Two SMB list views and the SMB pipeline report filter on Record Type = Master and keep working because SMB stays on the generic record type; no Flow filters on record type (Q9). No artefact in this step names any of them.
decision_record.element: none - the answer is what this step deliberately does NOT write

decision_record.question: record-types-and-page-layouts: 'Are Person Accounts enabled on this org?'
decision_record.answer: DEFAULT APPLIED - assumption A6: not enabled, so no personAccountDefault element is needed. Nothing in this step carries a record-type visibility block in any case; those are M2-S02's.
decision_record.source: documented default - assumption A6 (Q41 unanswered at G1)

decision_record.question: object-creation-and-design: 'Which field changes must be auditable, and who is asking?'
decision_record.answer: No field-level history is requested for either new field and no OpportunitySettings file ships (assumption A4), so both fields carry <trackHistory>false</trackHistory> and <trackFeedHistory>false</trackFeedHistory> explicitly rather than depending on an object flag this build does not set. Q39's stage-history question is separately recorded as a pre-go-live check in deploy-order.md section 3.

decision_record.question: Where does the discount live - Opportunity header or OpportunityLineItem?
decision_record.answer: A header field on the Opportunity, typed by the rep as the overall deal discount; line-item discounts are not used (Q12). Percent, precision 5, scale 2 per the step input - precision is the TOTAL digit count, so 5/2 is three digits left of the point and two right.
decision_record.source: clarification Q12 + step inputs (fields) + skills/admin/custom-field-creation references/metadata-examples.md section 3 for the precision/scale semantics

decision_record.question: Does Approval_Status__c carry a default value?
decision_record.answer: No - all three values are <default>false</default>. Q22 lists blank as a legal fourth state ('Pending, Approved, Rejected, blank'), set by the approval process, so a default would put every new Opportunity into a status nobody submitted.

decision_record.question: sales-process-mapping: 'Do renewals run these same stages, or does the CSM run something else?'
decision_record.answer: Different sequence - Renewal Review / Renewal Proposed / Closed Won / Closed Lost - which is two Sales Processes and therefore two Record Types (decision D2, assumption A1). The Path constraint settles what the stage lists left open: only one PathAssistant per record type per object.
decision_record.source: requirement.md item 1 + decision D2 + assumption A1
decision_record.element: the two businessProcess files and the two recordType files

decision_record.question: sales-process-mapping: 'What does the board pack call each forecast bucket?'
decision_record.answer: The standard forecast-category vocabulary (assumption A2). The design map speaks labels, the deployed XML speaks enum tokens: Q5's 'Commit' is <forecastCategory>Forecast</forecastCategory>. The word 'Commit' appears nowhere in any emitted file.
decision_record.source: assumption A2 + step note + admin/opportunity-management references/gotchas.md Gotcha 13

decision_record.question: change-management-and-deployment: what order must these components deploy in?
decision_record.answer: Value set, then business processes, then record types; the two custom fields are independent of that chain. One deploy resolves all four types together; the order matters for a split deploy and for reading failures. Outside-step dependencies (M1-S02 layouts, M2-S02 profile assignments, M2-S03/S04 validation rules, M3 approval process) are named in deploy-order.md section 2.
decision_record.source: cited skills' gotchas (opportunity-management Gotcha 6; record-types #6) + admin/change-management-and-deployment references/llm-anti-patterns.md Anti-Pattern 4
